raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) delivered customer_id in lowercase (e.g. 'c00138'). That raises distinct customer_ids to 361 against 200 in the dimension. Those rows fail the case-sensitive join to silver_customers, so 318 POSTED rows drop out of gold_region_daily, and gold_customer_spend splits each affected customer into two keys. Normalizing customer_id to uppercase in silver_transactions restores the join, since the IDs otherwise match the 'C00###' format.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'", "silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers"}}
